evidence_identity_contract: The complete freeze_tuple and run_id apply to every case. All SHA values are transcribed from this owner-frozen final inventory input, not computed locally. Each existing case JSON was read for its same run/source/binary and declared state. Current C5 source is not evidence for C4.
review_method: Every assigned new original candidate was opened with tools.view_image after static reads of case/state/metadata/actions/log. All native captures are portrait 930x1240; physical references are 1860x2480 at scale 2. ui-ux-pro-max guidance and frozen Scribe scope/plan apply. Previously actually viewed references are reused with explicit prior report identities. REMOTE_QUIET_NATIVE was observed: no program/test/build/probe/automatic verification/SSH/hash/copy/crop/image processing occurred, and no mechanical pass was used as a visual verdict.
capture_diagnostic_context: The final capture manifest is mechanically unsuccessful and incomplete. This report covers only eight present assigned frames; no missing or aborted case is invented and no business success follows from a mechanical flag.
